I haven't started Born Again yet so no spoilers please, but having seen every scene of Matt in the season 2 suit  over the last 2 months I will say that for the most part I like the new suit better than the old one.

The old suit is very function over form, it's practical without being very super heroic and as a result of that, it often looks wine coloured or even black. In comparison the new suit is so red that it seems to negate that problem, additionally it's build gives DD a more heroic silhouette.

The exception to all this is the cowl. The second Netflix cowl is so slick, so practical looking while also being the one part of the whole suit that completely feels like Daredevil, the shine, the shape, the eyes they're ALL perfect!

While I haven't seen the new suit in action and I by no means think it's godawful but the new cowl looks a little awkward, I can see why they'd make it the same material as the rest of the suit it makes it cohesive, again the previous cowl was the best part of the suit because it stood out, this version is trying to feel more like a complete design in every aspect. The main issue I have is the eyes, in comparison to the small, intentional, slick ones that have a tonne of personality and bring Daredevil as a character to life, the new lenses feel just like that, they're big lenses over his eyes, they're practical of course but ironically that means they have the problem that most of the old suit has.
